gen-fs-nippo-gf-savate: Savate has a tall, rounded o that nearly matches its capital, with curves that stay open and stems that run a touch heavier. And Nippo, up top, looks cut from wire, with small letters standing almost capital-sized.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Nippo draws every letter like cut wire, with no hairlines anywhere in the alphabet, and its small letters stand nearly capital-sized. Schibsted Grotesk sits below, friendly and plain sans.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-sen: Sen builds its lowercase tall, each letter traced by one steady line. Nippo adds the sharper edge above, with wire-cut strokes and no hairlines, which gives the pair a technical streak that stays modern.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-sintony: Sintony reads smooth and chunky, its tall midzone free of clogged curves. Nippo, with strokes like a steel cable outline, is made for the big moment, while Sintony handles the sentences that follow.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans stands its lowercase tall, like cut acrylic stencil pieces, with rounded letters and no thick-and-thin shift. Nippo does the loud work with its wire-cut display strokes, while Sofia Sans carries the quieter text.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-sono: Sono spreads its tall lowercase wide, each a left slightly ajar. Sono stays friendly under Nippo, whose drawing-pen lines and nearly capital-sized small letters give the top its technical bite.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-stack-sans-notch: Wire-cut and technical, that is Nippo, with small letters standing nearly capital-sized. Stack Sans Notch follows with big-bodied lowercase and open curves of rod-stock thickness, a sturdy sans-serif partner.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-stack-sans-text: Wire-cut letters, tall and technical: that is Nippo, with small forms nearly capital-sized. Stack Sans Text is the quiet one, drawing a marker-like line with big-bodied lowercase and curve endings held well apart.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-sulphur-point: Sulphur Point reads bulky and steady, with a marker-like line and clear gaps in its c, e, s and a. Text flows easily under Nippo's wire-cut display letters.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-tiktok-sans: Modern is the mood, with Nippo's tubelike, constant-weight lines leading and small letters nearly capital-sized. TikTok Sans has an x-height close to cap height, so a heading made small would lose its edge against it.
